name: actions-sanity
displayName: Actions Sanity — GitHub Actions workflow lint: script injection, unpinned actions, token scope
description: Lints .github/workflows in the editor. Finds script injection from untrusted ${{ github.event }} inputs, untrusted checkouts under pull_request_target, third-party actions on a moving tag or branch, jobs running on a write-scoped default token, needs: that point at nothing, and caches that never hit. No Go binary, no hosted service, no CI run.

actionsSanity.disabledRules.description: Rules never reported. `no-timeout` is off by default because it is true of almost every workflow ever written — measured against 40 real ones it fired 88 times. Remove it from this list if you care about runner minutes.
